LanguageData.GR_StrandedSGTeam_StartingGearSummary: The four starting pawns wear complete olive-drab SG-team field equipment.
LanguageData.GR_StrandedSGTeam_GameStartDialog:
A reconnaissance mission went wrong. The local Stargate became unusable before your extraction and contact with the SGC is impossible.
Your SG team recovered its field equipment, four bedrolls and several emergency-supply crates. Establish a camp, survive and prepare for the local powers that may already control this world.
